Dialogs.Dialog: Hey Doc, Luke speaking. There’s no news from the central. We are trying to remain calm, but it seems like it’s taking a toll on Theo. He is being more unbearable than usual. Also, the patient won’t stop trembling, it seems like anesthesia is losing its effect. Hope you’re safe.
